messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Using Camtrap R
parts:
Hello Kathan,

I am sorry, but I am not sure what exactly you are trying to do. Can you elaborate please?
Generally, recordTable requires some sort of species ID. Please see vignette 2 for details.

https://jniedballa.github.io/camtrapR/articles/camtrapr2.html

How did you geotag images? Do you mean sorting them into station directories? Or actually assigning coordinates to the images?

Best,

Jürgen
